raw.rationale: Trifluoperazine is a phenothiazine that at 2.5 µM broadly inhibits calmodulin and multiple GPCRs, causing non-selective cytotoxicity across most lineages; PRISM single-point data show few if any lineage-selective kills, with possible weak selectivity in CNS or lung lines due to dopamine/calmodulin dependencies. Probabilities are kept near the upper end of the stated base rate for lineages with plausible target expression and near the lower end for others.
